name: Erect Dayflower
desc: Erect Dayflower (Commelina erecta): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Commelina erecta, commonly known as white mouth dayflower, slender dayflower, or widow's tears. C. erecta is a blue flower often recognized by its two large blue petals and smaller white petal.
